It's your all-in-one dashboard to manage your subscription, change your username, and configure your API keys. 🔒 Security & Setup To activate the system, you must link an active Stake API key. install.setup: 📥 Setup Guide Takes about 2 minutes — follow along step by step. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 1️⃣ Install Tampermonkey Add the Tampermonkey extension from your browser's store (Chrome, Brave, Edge, or any Chromium browser). Then enable developer access: • Open Manage Extensions • Open Tampermonkey → Details • Turn on Allow User Scripts 2️⃣ Install the userscript Tap 📜 Install Userscript below, then click Install on the Tampermonkey page that opens. 3️⃣ Connect your license • Open Stake in your browser • Enter your license key in the Tampermonkey popup • Run /connected to confirm you're online 4️⃣ Log in to Stake • Normal session login → Offers page • API login → VIP Club page (any supported Stake mirror works too)
install.optimize: ⚙️ Optimization & Best Practices Recommended for stable, 24×7 claiming. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🚀 Browser performance Open chrome://settings/performance (Browser → Settings → Performance), then: • Add every Stake tab under Always keep these sites active • Disable Memory Saver for Stake tabs 🌐 DNS (recommended) Open chrome://settings/security (Browser → Settings → Privacy & Security → Security), then under Use secure DNS select Cloudflare (1.1.1.1). 🖥️ Running many usernames If you run more than 5 usernames, spread them across multiple browser profiles, PCs, laptops, or RDPs. For the best speed and stability, keep a maximum of 3 usernames per browser profile. Need a hand? Tap 🛟 Support anytime.
